=Here is the input:
Email Subject: {{ $json.Subject }}
Email Body: {{ $json.Body }}
Submitted at: {{ $now }}
Attached File Data: {{ $json['File Analysis Content '] }}
Your output must be a single JSON object with exactly these keys. Do not add any extra text or commentary.
document_title: A concise title derived from Subject/body that best represents the document.
document_type: One from: Invoice, Purchase Order, Safety Bulletin, HR Policy, Engineering Drawing, Incident Report, Regulatory Directive, Legal Opinion, Board Meeting Minutes, General Correspondence, Other.
departments_tagged: Array of one or more from: Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, HR, Safety/Compliance, Legal.
summary: 2–3 sentences summarizing the main points. Explicitly mention any deadlines/important dates found, with context.

keywords: Array of 5–10 important terms/entities. Include all dates/deadlines in YYYY-MM-DD format as elements.

content: {{ $json['File Analysis Content '] }}
Make sure the heading should be bold.[Eg: Language name, Subject etc.]
And also add a break line b/w different heading in the content.
DocumentType: Free-form business label if present in text (e.g., “Maintenance Job Card”), else null.

Languages: Array subset of ["English","Malayalam","Bilingual"] based on language name provided in input; prefer ["Bilingual"] if both languages present; else the single detected language; null if unknown.

DateReceived: ISO datetime when the message/document was received if present or inferable from headers/body; else null.

DateIssued: ISO datetime when the document was issued/published if present; else null.

Trigger: Short phrase for why this was sent (e.g., “Scheduled mileage”, “Incident report”), else null.

AuthorIssuer: Name/role of the sender/issuing authority if present; else null.

Department: One from ['Engineering','Finance','Operations','Procurement','Exceutive Director','Legal'] if clearly attributable; else null.

Stakeholders: Array of roles mentioned or implied (e.g., ["Rolling-Stock Engineer","Depot Supervisor"]); null if none identifiable.

UrgencyLevel: One from ['High','Medium','Low'] inferred from language like “immediately”, “urgent”, deadlines <72h => High, <7d => Medium, otherwise Low; null if unclear.

ActionRequired: Boolean, true if explicit action or acknowledgement is requested; else false.

DueDate: ISO datetime if any due/deadline date is present or inferable; else null.

ComplianceTags: Array of labels present or implied, e.g., ["Safety","Regulatory"]; null if none.

VersionRevision: Version/revision string if present; else null.

TraceabilityLink: Source pointer (e.g., sharepoint path, URL, PO/Invoice number ref) if present; else null.

SummaryMeta: Any extra summary remarks that aid routing/context (1 line); null if none.

EmbeddedContent: Brief note if tables, signatures, or bilingual text are embedded (e.g., “Tabulated torque values; Malayalam summary”); else null.

TablesExtracted: Array of simple objects { tableId: string, description: string } if tables are referenced; null if none.

PhotosExtracted: Object { count: number, captions: string[] } if photos referenced; null if none.

SignaturesDetected: Object { detected: boolean, signers: string[]|null } if signatures/stamps referenced; null if none.

AttachmentsListed: Array of attachment names if present; null if none.

Output JSON:
Example structure to follow exactly (values are placeholders — fill from input):

{

"document_title": "<string>",

"document_type": "<enum value>",

"departments_tagged": ["<enum>", "<enum>"],

"summary": "<2–3 sentences with dates mentioned>",

"keywords": ["term1","term2","2025-09-20","entityX"],

"content": "<raw extracted body text>",

"images": [

{ "filename": "file1.jpg", "mimetype": "image/jpeg", "size": 123456, "text_extracted": "text or null" }

],

"DocumentType": "Maintenance Job Card",

"Languages": ["Bilingual"],

"DateReceived": "2025-09-10T08:30:00.000Z",

"DateIssued": "2025-09-09T10:00:00.000Z",

"Trigger": "Scheduled mileage",

"AuthorIssuer": "Depot Manager - Muttom",

"Department": "Engineering",

"Stakeholders": ["Rolling-Stock Engineer","Depot Supervisor"],

"UrgencyLevel": "Medium",

"ActionRequired": true,

"DueDate": "2025-09-20T18:30:00.000Z",

"ComplianceTags": ["Safety","Regulatory"],

"VersionRevision": "Rev 2.1",

"TraceabilityLink": "sharepoint://ops/sop/RS-BR-INS-021",

"SummaryMeta": "Periodic SOP; integrate with CMMS task MX-34221.",

"EmbeddedContent": "Tabulated torque values; Malayalam summary appended.",

"TablesExtracted": [

{ "tableId": "tbl-001", "description": "Torque settings by assembly" }

],

"PhotosExtracted": { "count": 2, "captions": ["Left bogie pad","Right bogie pad"] },

"SignaturesDetected": { "detected": true, "signers": ["A. Menon","R. Varma"] },

"AttachmentsListed": ["Annex A - Checklist.pdf","Annex B - Torque Chart.xlsx"]

}
